1 fair copy, though they hardly count as improvements. Morn (1839/Athenaeum 1832) for
moon (Nbk 11) in l. 9 must be a mistranscription; however, the word is not perfectly formed
in Nbk 11 and so is susceptible to misreading. 1839’s hue for yew (Nbk 11/Athenaeum 1832)
